look_kind: EXPLORATORY ESTIMATION (no verdict, no programme-bar test, no discovery claim; informs whether the event-sourced lane is built)

data.form4_store: ~/.alphalens/form4_parquet/ (VPS source of truth, synced to the analysis host 2026-09-03; survivor-biased: 12% of issuers delisted 2007-2018 present)
data.prices: ~/.alphalens/prices/<TICKER>.parquet (yfinance daily OHLCV; survivors only; tickers missing for cluster events fetched 2026-09-03 through yfinance_cache.download_and_cache)
data.acceptance_times: EDGAR filing header <ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME> per completing accession, fetched through get_default_sec_client(), cached at ~/.alphalens/edgar_acceptance/
data.universe_primary: every ticker present in the Form-4 store with a price history covering the event window (disclosed survivor set; owner decision 2026-09-03 for power)

event.leg: transaction_code P, acquired_disposed A, is_amendment False, is_officer or is_director, price present, shares*price >= 10000 USD
event.cluster: >= 2 distinct reporting_owner_cik with qualifying legs filed within 2 trading sessions of the anchor leg; cluster USD >= 100000 (250000 reported as a strength check, not a second test)
event.event_date: filed_date of the leg that completes the insider count (2nd distinct insider)
event.dedup: one event per ticker per 20 sessions, first wins
exclusions: completing leg filed > 10 business days after its transaction_date (late filing)
no price row on the anchor session
split guard: any day-over-day close ratio in the window outside [0.55, 1.8]
covariates_stamped_never_filters: Cohen-Malloy label of each buyer (classifier_year = event year)
first_leg_date and car from the first leg

arrival_and_anchor.rule: acceptance before 09:00 ET on the filing date -> same-session OPEN; otherwise (intraday, post-close, unknown) -> next-session OPEN

secondary: Carhart-4F residual of the treated basket (robustness)

controls.pool: universe tickers priced on the arrival session with no qualifying purchase leg in [-20, 0] sessions (a later purchase inside the window is stamped, never used to delete the control)
controls.method: nearest neighbour in standardized matching space (pool sd per arrival month), each variable within a 1.5 sd caliper; same calendar month by construction (same arrival session)

inference.statistic: mean over events of d_i = car_20(treated_i) - mean(car_20 of matched controls_i)
inference.clusters: arrival sessions (primary); two-way ticker x arrival session reported as sensitivity
inference.co_primary_sensitivity: regression car_20 ~ treated + match_vars on the pooled treated+control rows, arrival-session clusters

planning_rule.fee_model: Saxo LIVE schedule on a fixed ticket: 0.08% per side + 0.25% FX each way (reference_saxo_fees_sim_vs_live_2026_07_29)
planning_rule.note: a planning rule, not a hypothesis-test verdict; the forward stage is the single confirmatory test

descriptive_outputs: retail simulation with 3- and 5-name caps, equal-dollar, fee model, first-come rule
delisted-issuer subset present in the store
abort_clause: abort uncharged only for outcome-blind defects (row counts, join integrity, universe gaps, price-cache holes, acceptance-fetch failures); the moment any treated-vs-control number is emitted the look is spent
review_trail: Perplexity reason (16) + zen deepseek-v4-pro (10), 2026-09-03; adjudication in the design memo §12
